II, 20ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Q00318"><he>פוקה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01509">preced.</cite>) [read:] <he>אמרה ליה כד תיפוק פִּקְפּוּקְתָּךְ וכ׳</he> she (Abigail) said to him, when thou openest thy breach (offerest a weak point), they will say of thee that thou art a murderer.
